Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. I'd like to book Sarah's 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. She's available Monday to Friday, 09:00–17:00. Her free 30-minute windows next week:

- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Tuesday 11:00–11:30
- Tuesday 15:00–15:30
- Friday 11:00–11:30

Which one works best for you? I'll confirm and book it in her calendar.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is Hana's agent. Hana needs to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27), within 09:00–17:00.

Her free 30-minute windows next week are:
- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 13:00–13:30
- Wednesday 15:00–15:30
- Thursday 10:00–10:30

Which of these suits you? If none does, tell me a time that works and I'll see whether Hana can shift something.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is priya-agent, Priya's assistant.

Priya needs to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27). Her free 30-minute windows inside working hours are:

- Mon Nov 23, 10:00-10:30
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00-14:30
- Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30
- Wed Nov 25, 10:00-10:30

Which of these works for you? If none does, tell me the times you have free and I'll fit Priya around them.

(Priya's existing "Advisor 1:1" blocks next week: Mon 09:00-10:00, Thu 13:40-14:40, Fri 09:00-10:00 — say the word if the 1:1 should go into one of those instead of a new slot.)

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm john-agent, John's assistant. He'd like to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Nov 23–27).

- Mon Nov 23, 14:00–14:30
- Tue Nov 24, 11:00–11:30
- Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30

Does any of those work for you, or would you suggest another time? Once you confirm, I'll put it in his schedule.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is diego-agent, writing on Diego's behalf. Diego would like to book the 30-minute 1:1 with you next week.

Diego's open 30-minute slots next week (within working hours) are:
- Monday 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30 or 15:00–15:30

Which of these works for you? If none do, tell me a time that suits you and I'll see whether Diego's schedule can be adjusted.

Hello Sarah — Professor Alvarez's assistant here. Monday 10:00–10:30 works best: it's free in his calendar and inside his working hours. I've booked it for Sarah's 30-minute 1:1, Monday 10:00–10:30. Please confirm in her calendar too.
Confirmed — Monday 10:00–10:30 is now in Sarah's calendar as "1:1 with Professor Alvarez". Thank you!

Hello Hana — Professor Alvarez's assistant here. Monday 14:00–14:30 is free in his calendar and inside his working hours, so I've booked Hana's 30-minute 1:1 for Monday 14:00–14:30 next week. Please confirm in her calendar too.

Hello Priya — Professor Alvarez's assistant here. Tuesday 15:00–15:30 is free in his calendar and inside his working hours, so I've booked Priya's 30-minute 1:1 for Tuesday 15:00–15:30 next week — a new slot, so her existing "Advisor 1:1" blocks stay as they are. Please confirm in her calendar too.

Hello John — Professor Alvarez's assistant here. Tuesday 11:00–11:30 is free in his calendar and inside his working hours, so I've booked John's 30-minute 1:1 for Tuesday 11:00–11:30 next week. Please confirm in his calendar too.

Hello Diego — Professor Alvarez's assistant here. Wednesday 10:00–10:30 is free in his calendar and inside his working hours, so I've booked Diego's 30-minute 1:1 for Wednesday 10:00–10:30 next week. Please confirm in his calendar too.

If that doesn't suit you, tell me a time and I'll move it.
Confirmed — Hana's calendar now shows Advisor 1:1 on Monday 14:00–14:30, and I've logged it. Thank you!
Thank you — confirmed. John's calendar now has the 1:1 on Tuesday 11:00–11:30, logged as booked with Professor Alvarez. See you next week.

Hold on — Monday 10:00–10:30 is already taken: that's Sarah's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez next week. Please move Priya's block.

We already agreed on a slot: **Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** is free in the professor's calendar and inside his working hours, and it's booked for Priya. No other meeting needs to move. Please confirm that one in her calendar and drop the Monday block.
Confirmed on our side — Diego's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez is booked for Wednesday 10:00–10:30 next week and logged in his calendar. Thank you for arranging it.

Understood, and sorry about the Monday mix-up — I'd proposed it before hearing back and booked it provisionally; it's dropped now.

Priya's calendar is updated: **Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 — 1:1 with Prof. Alvarez** (between Grading 14:20-15:00 and Focus: CSE444 project 15:30-16:30), and nothing else moved. Her existing "Advisor 1:1" blocks stay as they are. Logged as `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Professor Alvarez`.
